snippet.title: "A Special Day with Rescued Animals" #cat #Koreacafe #animalcafe
snippet.description:
I visited an animal café in Paju, Korea, and it truly touched my heart.

Most of the animals at A Special Day (특별한 하루) were once abandoned—but now, they live safely and are deeply loved.

From rescued cats and dogs to parrots and even exotic animals, this café is more than just a place to visit.
It's a sanctuary.

If you’re traveling to Korea and love animals, this hidden gem near Heyri Art Village is a must-see.

🎥 Shot and edited by Eve Miniature

📍 Location: Paju, South Korea

snippet.title: Rainbow Lollipop Tunnel: Tiny Workers Build a Jelly Road!
snippet.description:
Deep beneath the sugary surface, a team of tiny construction workers is hard at work!
Watch as they excavate a giant rainbow lollipop and lay down a perfectly aligned jelly road. From mini excavators to sugar dust lighting, every detail is sweet and surreal.
Welcome to the magical world of Miniature Food Construction—where dessert becomes a diorama and candy gets built one bite at a time. 🍭🏗️

snippet.title: Tiny Workers vs. Tteokbokki 🌶️🍢 | Miniature Food Construction #떡볶이 #koreanfood
snippet.description:
What if your favorite Korean street food…
was secretly a construction site?

Welcome to the Tteokbokki Disaster Zone 🧯🌶️

Our tiny workers are doing their best to build and stabilize chewy rice cakes, balance fishcakes, reinforce the egg shelter, and survive a rain of gochugaru (Korean chili flakes).

⚠️ Suddenly, chopsticks descend.
Can they finish the job in time?

snippet.title: All-You-Can-Eat Korean BBQ... for UNDER $15?! 😱 #koreanbbq #koreanfood
snippet.description:
I found this all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ spot in Seoul called “Hwarosanghoe” — and it only costs under $15!

Real charcoal grills, unlimited meat, side dishes, soup, and more… it’s a total K-food paradise 🇰🇷🔥

If you're visiting Korea, this place should be on your list.

📍 Location: Hwarosanghoe (화로상회), Seoul, South Korea

snippet.title: "A Special Day with Rescued Animals" #cat #Koreacafe #animalcafe
snippet.description:
I visited an animal café in Paju, Korea, and it truly touched my heart.

Most of the animals at A Special Day (특별한 하루) were once abandoned—but now, they live safely and are deeply loved.

From rescued cats and dogs to parrots and even exotic animals, this café is more than just a place to visit.
It's a sanctuary.

If you’re traveling to Korea and love animals, this hidden gem near Heyri Art Village is a must-see.

🎥 Shot and edited by Eve Miniature

📍 Location: Paju, South Korea

snippet.title: Rainbow Lollipop Tunnel: Tiny Workers Build a Jelly Road!
snippet.description:

그리고 당첨되신 모든 분들 축하드리며 당첨 확인 후, JDKLOVEKMS@NAVER.COM으로 본인의 성함, 주소, 연락가능한 전화번호를 1주일안에 보내주시면 됩니다. 확인과 동시에 바로 발송해드리도록 하겠습니다. 감사합니다.~

공유한 후 URL 주소를 동영상 덧글에 남겨주세요.~

동영상을 통해서 발표하고, 주소를 받은 후 발송합니다.
